{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.04

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's vest magazines.

|s1= [[magazinesDetailVest]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|s2= [[magazinesDetailVest]] [unit, includeEmpty, includeLoaded]

|s2since= arma3 2.00

|p21= unit: [[Object]] - unit

|p22= includeEmpty: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to include empty magazines

|p23= includeLoaded: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to include magazines loaded in weapons (Since Arma 3 v2.07.148195)

|r2= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>
magazinesDetailVest player;
/*
[
	["6.5 mm 30Rnd Sand Mag(30/30)[id/cr:10000012/0]",
	"RGO Grenade(1/1)[id/cr:10000016/0]",
	"RGO Grenade(1/1)[id/cr:10000017/0]"]
]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[magazinesDetail]] [[magazinesDetailUniform]] [[magazinesDetailBackpack]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Leopard20
|timestamp= 20210912220744
|text= To return the ammo count in each magazine, you can use this code:
<sqf>
magazinesDetailVest player apply {
	private _reverse = reverse _x;
	private _i1 = (_reverse find "[)") + 1;
	private _i2 = (_reverse find ["/", _id1]) + 1;
	private _i3 = _reverse find ["(", _id2];
	parseNumber reverse (_reverse select [_i2, _i3 - _i2]); // return cnt
};
</sqf>
}}
